comment: No `dependencies` block, deliberately: the ephemeris toolchain is build-time only (CLAUDE.md §1.5) and /api/subscribe stays framework-free. Scripts and devDependencies are added by the phase that first uses them — astronomy-engine and `validate` arrive in Phase 3.
